senses.gloss: --had five sons; all powerful. वा. ६८. ३०. [page२-070+ ३१]
(I)--a son of काश्यप and Diti; appointed Purohita. Br. IV. 9. 3.
(II)--६१ days and nights. वा. ५०. १८६.
(III)--a son of Angirasa. वा. ६५. १०५.
(IV)--known for माया. वा. ६९. ९३.

--the great Asuras, १०० in number, chief of them being Vipracitti; all resolute and bold; blessed after long and severe penance; truthful, powerful, cruel, magical; not performers of sacrifice; unbrahmanical; a list of the chief names; some of them took to human धर्म। वा. ६८. 1-१६.
--see Andhaka. Br. III. ७१. ११८.
--a son of उमा and महादेव. वा. ७२. १६.
--cleaning the teeth with sticks of six trees like the अश्वत्थ and the banyan; part of कृष्णाष्टमी vrata. M. ५६. 8. [page२-071+ ३५]
--an elephant. वा. ६९. २२१.

(I)--a son of युधिष्ठिर's aunt and brother of Caidya, (s.v.).
1: भा. VII. 1. ३२-46; १०. ३८.
Helped जरासन्ध in his siege of मथुरा and Gomanta by guarding the eastern gate of the former, and the western gate of the latter with his brother.
2: Ib. X. ५०. ११ [2]; ५२. ११ [११]. Vi. V. २६. 7.
Attended the conference summoned by शाल्व to defeat the Yadus, and got angry at शाल्व's death.
3: भा. X. ७६. 2 [१०]; ७७. ३७.
Arrival at कुण्डिन;
4: Ib. X. ५३. १७; ६०. १८.
was the king of Kalinga; when he heard that कृष्ण was returning from the यमुना to द्वारका, he waylaid him to discharge the debt he owed to his friends. He struck कृष्ण on the head but was himself hit on his chest; when he fell dead, a spark entered कृष्ण's body and he became one with the Lord.
5: Ib. X. ७८. 1-१३; ३७. १९; II. 7. ३४; III. 3. ११; VII. 1. १७.

(II)--(Dantavakra-वा। प्।)--a son of Diti, and cursed by a sage; was born of श्रुतदेवा;
1: भा. IX. २४. ३७; Br. IV. २९. १२२; वा. ९६. १५५.
and वृद्धधर्म, the कारूष king.
2: Br. III. ७१. १५६; Vi. IV. १४. ४०.
--see गणनाथ. Br. IV. २७. ७७.
(I)--one of the २८ hells; the cruel and merciless are tormented here by reptiles and others. भा. V. २६. 7 and ३३.
(II)--the name of a serpant born of क्रोधवशा. भा. VI. 6. २८. [page२-072+ २६]
(III)--a follower of वृत्र in his battle with Indra. भा. VI. १०. [२०].
(I)--a Sukha God. Br. IV. 1. १९. [page२-082+ ४१]
(II)--a Mukhya गण. वा. १००. १८.
--a group of sages. M. २००. १७.
--a class of people in शाकद्वीप. भा. V. २०. २७. [page२-083+ ३४]
--a son of प्रीति and Pulastya; Agastya in pre- vious birth; wife Sujanghi, had many sons known as Paulastyas. Br. II. ११. २६.
--a Sukha God. Br. IV. 1. १८.
--a सुधामान God. Br. II. ३६. २७.
